messages:
ravi: Postmortem follow-up: recurring pattern of short timeouts and truncated streaming responses during high fanout. We need owners for reconnect/backoff, server chunk handling, and an oncall playbook. Assign and add ticket IDs.

emma: Ill take reconnect/backoff for client SDK + edge proxy. Plan: single-flight handshake, capped parallel handshakes, exponential backoff with full jitter. Will open RDW-6401. ETA Mon EOD.

jon: Ill own server chunk handling. Hypothesis: writer flush cadence + GC pauses create chunk gaps that look like partials. Plan: add chunk pacing (min interval) and ack batching. Ticket RDW-6402. ETA Wed.

ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-04-12-streaming-timeout-cluster. Linked: RDW-6401, RDW-6402.

zoe: I can do the oncall playbook + dashboards: add chunk_gap histogram and an alert that escalates if partial_rate > 0.06 for 5m. Ticket RDW-6403. ETA Tue noon.

emma: Draft client config: 

```
reconnect:
  single_flight: true
  base_ms: 180
  max_ms: 45000
  jitter: full
  max_attempts: 6
```

jon: Staging toggles: 

```
streaming:
  writer_flush_ms: 25
  min_chunk_interval_ms: 12
  ack_batch_ms: 60
```

jon: I added a synthetic load test (15k concurrent streams with spikes) and repro'd partials. Increasing min_chunk_interval to 12ms reduced partial_rate by ~40% in staging. Will try ack batching next.

zoe: Playbook will include manual canary steps (2% -> 10%), rollback commands, and dashboard links.

emma: RDW-6401 created and PR draft up. ETA Mon 2026-04-13 23:59 UTC for merge.

jon: RDW-6402 PR targeted Wed 2026-04-15 18:00 UTC. Will include reproducible metrics and canary plan.

zoe: RDW-6403 dashboards + alert rules live by Tue 2026-04-14 12:00 UTC.

ravi: Thanks. Ill schedule a 30m sync Thu 2026-04-16 10:00 to review canary metrics. Please post CI and canary links here when available.

emma: Will post client load graphs to RDW-6401 once CI finishes. :white_check_mark:

jon: Adding a brief retrospective note to RDW-6402 after canary verification.

ops-bot: Reminder: rate-limited alerts will be applied to INC-2026-04-12-streaming-timeout-cluster during manual canary to avoid noisy paging.

ravi: Closing loop: we will close this thread when all three tickets are merged and canaryed for 48h with partial_rate < 1%.
